title: Highland Legends
author: Thomas Dick Lauder

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Dick Lauder (1784–1848) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
works: The Wolfe of Badenoch: A Historical Romance of the Fourteenth Century

description: "Highland Legends" by Sir Thomas Dick Lauder is a collection of historical tales and folklore written in the late 19th century. The book explores various legends from the Scottish Highlands, delving into themes of heroism, nature, and the cultural history of the region.
